desc: A true show stopper with its red accents, weighted mag cap, ported barrel, sleek nickel receiver, jet black finish ported barrel, and elegant satin walnut stock. The ACE is powered by Retay’s Straight Line Inertial Transfer System, the patented Inertia Plus Bolt Rollover Torsion Spring Action, and the Dead Straight Deep-Bore Drilled Barrel for maximum performance. It offers on target, no float aiming and Retay’s Out of the Box Optimization Factory-Lengthened Forcing Cone.
